statement.essentials: A common incision runs in the crease in front of the ear, curves around the earlobe, and continues into a natural neck crease below the jaw.
statement.anatomy: The modified Blair incision is a common approach; a facelift-type incision is an alternative in selected cases.

sources.locator: Operative procedure: incision and flap elevation; sample dictation

limitations: Incision choice varies by surgeon and tumour.
